label: Glazing type
scoring_rule: Triple/high-performance = 1; double/multiple = 0.75; secondary = 0.5; single = 0.

label: Multiple-glazing proportion
scoring_rule: Reported percentage ÷ 100.

label: Glazed area category
scoring_rule: Much less than typical = 1; less = 0.75; normal = 0.5; more = 0.25; much more = 0.

label: Top-storey flat status
scoring_rule: Flats/maisonettes only: top storey = 0; other storey = 1. Other dwelling types are excluded.

label: Corridor heat-loss category
scoring_rule: Heated corridor or no corridor = 1; unheated corridor = 0.

label: Heated-room share
scoring_rule: Heated rooms ÷ habitable rooms; ratios outside 0–1 are excluded.

label: Normalised unheated corridor length
scoring_rule: Unheated corridor length ÷ √floor area, only where an unheated corridor is recorded. P1–P99 scale [0.1154, 2.026], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Open fireplace density
scoring_rule: Open fireplaces ÷ habitable rooms; if room count is missing, divide by (floor area ÷ 20). P1–P99 scale [0, 0.4], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Current energy-efficiency score
scoring_rule: Reported current energy-efficiency score. P1–P99 scale [22, 88], clipped to 0–1.

label: Current energy consumption
scoring_rule: Reported current energy use (kWh/m²/year). P1–P99 scale [43, 651], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Current environmental-impact score
scoring_rule: Reported current environmental-impact score. P1–P99 scale [21, 93], clipped to 0–1.

label: Reported CO₂ emissions intensity
scoring_rule: Reported CO₂ emissions per floor area (kg/m²/year). P1–P99 scale [8, 115], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Derived CO₂ emissions intensity
scoring_rule: 1,000 × current CO₂ emissions (tonnes/year) ÷ floor area (m²). P1–P99 scale [7.627, 114.7], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Heating cost per floor area
scoring_rule: Reported annual cost (£) ÷ floor area (m²). P1–P99 scale [1.741, 24.81], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Hot-water cost per floor area
scoring_rule: Reported annual cost (£) ÷ floor area (m²). P1–P99 scale [0.4779, 7.429], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Lighting cost per floor area
scoring_rule: Reported annual cost (£) ÷ floor area (m²). P1–P99 scale [0.4955, 2.172], clipped to 0–1; reversed.

label: Low-energy lighting proportion
scoring_rule: Reported low-energy lighting percentage ÷ 100.

label: Low-energy fixed-lighting share
scoring_rule: Low-energy fixed outlets ÷ all fixed outlets; ratios outside 0–1 are excluded.

label: Lighting description
scoring_rule: No low-energy lighting = 0; all fixed lighting = 1; otherwise extract the reported percentage ÷ 100.

label: Solar water heating
scoring_rule: Yes = 1; no = 0.

label: Photovoltaic supply proportion
scoring_rule: Reported photovoltaic electricity supply percentage ÷ 100.

label: Wind turbine presence
scoring_rule: Recorded turbine count > 0 = 1; recorded zero = 0.
